caption: A closed desk in the Desks menu and the routing label in the top bar
preconditions: Desk 'Culture' is open before the shot. The first step closes it and routes it to 'Politics' through PATCH /api/closed_desks/<Culture _id> (If-Match: the desk _etag), the same call the Desk Router widget makes with 'Start routing'; the cleanup reopens it

steps.script: (async () => { const api = window.appConfigLoaded.server.url; const H = {Authorization: localStorage.getItem('sess:token'), 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}; const desk = async (n) => (await (await fetch(api + '/desks?where=' + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({name: n})), {headers: H})).json())._items[0]; const c = await desk('Culture'); const p = await desk('Politics'); if (c.is_closed) { return; } const r = await fetch(api + '/closed_desks/' + c._id, {method: 'PATCH', headers: {...H, 'If-Match': c._etag}, body: JSON.stringify({is_closed: true, closed_destination: p._id})}); if (!r.ok) { throw new Error('closing Culture failed: ' + r.status + ' ' + (await r.text())); } })()

steps: wait for [data-test-id="monitoring--select-desk-options"] li.desk-item--closed to be visible
move the mouse away from the list
notes: Culture shows in red with an icon in the Desks menu, Politics shows a green icon (desk-item--receiving), and the top bar on the right reads 'Routing to: Politics'. The dropdown classes are applied about 500 ms after the desk changes, so wait for the class, not just the menu. Cleanup reopens the desk so later shots on other pages are not affected. New image, there was none before.

cleanup.script: (async () => { const api = window.appConfigLoaded.server.url; const H = {Authorization: localStorage.getItem('sess:token'), 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}; const c = (await (await fetch(api + '/desks?where=' + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({name: 'Culture'})), {headers: H})).json())._items[0]; if (!c.is_closed) { return; } const r = await fetch(api + '/closed_desks/' + c._id, {method: 'PATCH', headers: {...H, 'If-Match': c._etag}, body: JSON.stringify({is_closed: false})}); if (!r.ok) { throw new Error('reopening Culture failed: ' + r.status + ' ' + (await r.text())); } })()
